bio: Co-founder @SuaraOps. Voice & WhatsApp ERP workflow agents for Indonesian supply chain & FMCG distributors.
discovered_via: SEG-03: SEA Vertical AI & Agent Founders

recent_posts.text: Off-the-shelf ASR models choke when warehouse supervisors mix Bahasa Indonesia, Javanese slang, and SKU codes in 85dB forklift noise. Fine-tuning Whisper-large-v3-turbo on 900 hours of real depot audio bumped our end-to-end ERP tool-call accuracy from 61% to 94%.
